create.title: Exact selector and ownership table for the beta compact cell
create.statement_tex: Starting from the accepted finite product Cauchy--Green ledger and fixed-w endpoint-free operator, expand every compact beta double-bounded stratum. For each row record its orientation, coefficient and contour measure, central/large-alpha recombination, terminal or routed status, named singular/smooth amplitude type, exact j=0 or j>=1 selector and physical profile, floors and stars, collision/corner convention, boundary-module exclusion, and unique external-normalization owner. The surviving mixed beta connector (1/4)A_u A_v[psi''(beta)Q_T] must appear explicitly. The table must prove equality with the actual post-routing compact remainder, not only membership in an abstract finite analytic class.
create.next_action: Derive a finite row-by-row table from the accepted sixteen-stratum product identity, including beta mixed connectors and exact physical j-selectors, then subject the table to strict isolated and hostile audits.

update.statement_tex: For the exact beta-owned compact cell Theta_db=psi(beta)chi_0(alpha), on the full actual contour 0<=a with a+b<1/2 and a/2+b<1/4, prove sup_x(|A(x)|+x|A'(x)|)=O_epsilon(X^epsilon). The corrected abstract finite-family estimate is polylogarithmic when multiplier x-derivatives, the j=0 hard and regular top selectors, the j>=1 interior selectors, signed Plemelj functional, exact floors/stars, and profile seminorms are included. Promotion still requires an exact row-by-row equality between that family and the actual post-routing compact operator plus a strict statement-only rederivation; the Round-43 isolated report was contaminated and the schematic packet omitted both the lower contour condition and the ownership table.
update.next_action: Construct the exact compact selector/ownership table, correct the contour and j-selectors in the packet, and obtain a genuinely isolated analytic proof before promotion.
Close the exact compact selector/ownership table and double-bounded cell, then compose with the proved large-alpha package. The alpha-bounded zeta-high branch remains separate.
Validate the corrected actual compact selector/ownership family and its strict isolated estimate; the large-alpha interfaces remain closed.

reject.reason: The packet's two upper inequalities admit negative a. Then p can be at most one, or the bottom active dyadic block can have polynomial weight. The actual contour has a>=0 and avoids this defect.
The physical decomposition has a j=0 regular-top profile and separate j>=1 interior profiles. Their estimates agree, but omitting selectors makes the one-count identity false.

Uniform finite cardinality and admissible seminorms prove only a class estimate. They do not map the sixteen product-Cauchy--Green strata, coefficients, measures, stars, collisions, and routed modules into named types.
Central/complementary alpha recombination cancels chi_0' and chi_0'' terms but leaves (1/4)A_uA_v[psi''(beta)Q_T], which needs explicit compact ownership.
The assigned validator disclosed proof-graph exposure. Its derivation is useful independent evidence but cannot count as the protocol's isolated rederivation.

no_change.reason: The beta double-bounded cell and alpha-bounded branch remain open.

round_assessment.reason: The abstract compact estimate is repaired and the actual obstruction is narrowed to an explicit, finite selector/ownership certificate. No target claim is promoted without the failed isolation and one-count gates.
